name: context-cockpit
description: A bar above the prompt for the desktop app: context gauge, compact button with auto and smart compact, subagent tracker and prompt-cache management.

autoCompactPercent.title: Auto-compact at (%)
autoCompactPercent.description: Default context percentage that triggers an automatic compact. Editable live in the compaction settings.

smartMinPercent.title: Smart compact only above (%)
smartMinPercent.description: Default context fill below which smart compact does not run. Editable live in the compaction settings.

preColdCompactPercent.title: Compact mode: only above (%)
preColdCompactPercent.description: In cache mode Compact, the compact before the cache goes cold only runs when the context is at least this full.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: 5m or 1h. Click the TTL in the bar to switch; a model switch also reports the real value.

leadSeconds.title: Act this many seconds before the cache goes cold
leadSeconds.description: Ping and Compact cache modes fire this long before the cache lifetime ends.

pingMax.title: Most pings per idle stretch
pingMax.description: Safety cap: after this many keep-alive pings in a row the cache is let go cold.

smartModel.title: Model for the smart check
smartModel.description: Alias or id of the cheap model that judges whether the context is still needed.
